purpose: Static and geometric proof for Infinite Domain's visible, fractally occluded Wasteland hex-grid cave system, covering both the canonical density codec and the hex-cave source module.

checks.check: the custom codec has one exact bounded geometry contract
checks.detail: 48-block cells carry 8-block corridors, 24-block chambers, three 11-block-high strata, and a 288-block protected origin

checks.check: the canonical Wastelands final-density router consumes the cave field
checks.detail: the new field wraps, rather than replaces, the prior terrain and vanilla cave/noodle density graph

checks.check: hex caves carve land without cutting the Abyssal oceans
checks.detail: continentalness -0.19..1.21 owns the carve; ocean values resolve to positive solid-preserving density

checks.check: world-seeded multi-octave plasma selectively occludes the literal grid
checks.detail: four NormalNoise octaves close only high positive lobes while lower values preserve or narrow the authored corridors

checks.check: sampled geometry contains literal chambers, six-sided corridors, and intervening walls
checks.detail: seven adjacent chamber centers and all six shared edges carve while six chamber-to-edge wall samples remain solid

checks.check: three cave strata and the spawn-hospital exclusion remain bounded
checks.detail: carve bands center at Y -40, 4, and 48; rock separates them; the field is inert above Y58 and within radius 288

checks.check: the installed project-owned companion supplies the registered codec
checks.detail: the installed JAR has the NeoForge mod entry point, registry class, geometry, and density-function implementation

checks.check: cave generation is worldgen-owned and multiplayer-safe
checks.detail: no quest, player, team, advancement, scoreboard, or game-stage token participates in the terrain graph

checks.check: the source module's carve is deterministic and coordinate-seeded
checks.detail: world seed and block coordinates alone drive the warped hex boundary, occlusion thresholds, chamber test, and the block-safety guards

checks.check: the source module is scoped to the Wasteland biome namespaces
checks.detail: the modifier adds one placed feature at UNDERGROUND_DECORATION for the the_wasteland_reworked and wastelands namespaces only

checks.check: the source module registers its feature and biome-modifier serializer
checks.detail: the mod entry point registers the hex_caves feature and the wasteland_namespace biome-modifier codec

checks.check: the source module's datapack resources match its registration contract
checks.detail: the configured feature, placed feature, and biome modifier resolve to the ids the mod registers

checks.check: the reference implementation reproduces the authored grid and occlusion budget
checks.detail: seed 123456789 over a 512x512 domain at step 2: 28.5% raw grid, 22.5% surviving, 6.0% occluded, 4.3% chambers

runtime_validation: This gate proves codec packaging, graph reachability, exact geometry, land/spawn bounds, source-module contracts, and multiplayer ownership. A fresh-world visual and performance pass remains required.
